title: Observability Inequalities and the Logvinenko-Sereda Theorem for the Dunkl Transform: the uniform cube-measure comparison (Lemma 4.1)
author: Xingyu Zhao, Longben Wei, Zhiwen Duan
work: Observability Inequalities and the Logvinenko-Sereda Theorem for the Dunkl Transform
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the paper's uniform comparison of Dunkl-weighted cube measures, printed as Lemma 4.1 (source0.tex lines 729-749) and delivered with the paper's own complete 241-line proof (lines 750-990). The statement bounds the relative measure defect of two concentric cubes by C M/(L+M) uniformly in the centre and the scale, and deduces both the uniform limit and the threshold form of the comparison. The proof is the paper's own long argument: it decomposes the difference of the two weighted measures into boundary layers, estimates the Dunkl weight's growth through the root system and the reflection-group parameters, controls the resulting sums and integrals uniformly in the centre, and assembles the constant C depending only on the dimension and the Dunkl parameters. This is a research-level harmonic-analysis estimate for the Dunkl setting rather than a qualifying-examination exercise, so the unit is H2. Delivered with the paper's own proof, in the paper's own notation, as the single primary proof body; the unit is H2.
